How to play Explosion Countdown

Count to 20. But one number is a bomb. Players count to 20 in order — but one number is secretly the 'bomb'. Whoever says it gets eliminated. Nobody knows which number until someone explodes.

2–10 players~8 minTense & StrategicMemory & chain games🚗 Works in the car

How to play

  1. Before the game, one player secretly picks a 'bomb' number between 1 and 20.
  2. Players take turns counting — one, two, three... — going around the circle.
  3. Whoever says the bomb number is eliminated.
  4. After each explosion, pick a new bomb number for the next round.
  5. You can say 1, 2, or 3 numbers per turn — but must say at least one.

Example round

  • Bomb is 7. '1, 2' → '3, 4, 5' → '6' → '7' — BOOM. Eliminated.
  • Smart play: say exactly the right amount to force the bomb onto someone else.
  • Everyone starts counting cautiously around number 10 even if the bomb is 3.

Tips

  • Watch others' faces — people slow down near the number they're afraid of.
  • For more chaos, let the bomb-picker give one cryptic hint.
